gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-michroma: Conthrax leads with a wide, geometric stance, its lowercase so tall the capitals barely rise above it. And Michroma follows in sans-serif, giving each letter a generous berth so the whole pairing feels spacious and measured.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-miriam-libre: Approachable and modern, Miriam Libre draws an s with generous openings between its bends. Miriam Libre holds its own at a modest size, while Conthrax stays the louder, geometric voice up top.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Mochiy Pop One reads big and round, its lowercase eyes unusually large. Conthrax runs above it in tidy geometric lines, and the two settle into a layout where the sans-serif text feels friendlier than the heading.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Approachable and clean, Mochiy Pop P One gives each letter a wide stretch of blank space. Conthrax sits above in its geometric display lines, and the plain sans below feels roomier and softer than the heading ever does.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-montserrat-underl: Wide, tidy and a little oversized. Conthrax holds the heading with an unvarying line, and Montserrat Underline follows with a plain sans whose lowercase looks big next to its own capitals.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-mozilla-headline: Mozilla Headline brings big-bodied lowercase letters and a splayed c terminal, friendly and contemporary in feel. But Conthrax does its best work as the geometric display voice with one constant pen width, leaving the sans to carry the text.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-mozilla-text: Neutral and sturdy, Mozilla Text looks bold in its lowercase because the bodies are so tall, with terminals flaring outward. Yet Conthrax is the one built to stand out, its pencil-like lines never pressing harder, while the sans simply carries the words.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-nata-sans: Conthrax opens with its wide-mouthed lowercase a and geometric display shapes, crisp and clean. Nata Sans then settles beneath it in sans-serif, with curved letters left wide open and a technical-pen steadiness.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-nobile: Professional and contemporary, Nobile keeps its lowercase close to cap height, with open mouths like unjoined chalk arcs. But shrink Conthrax down and its drawn-string line loses the presence it has at display size.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-nokora: Conthrax opens as a skeleton outline given one fixed stroke thickness, geometric and spare. But Nokora lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line, and its wide-open s makes the sans-serif body feel friendly.
